title: Native pro-etale projection-mate shift and exactness data
statement: For a morphism f : X ⟶ Y of schemes, commutative-ring sheaves R on Y and S on X, an identification c : f⁻¹R ≅ S, native pro-etale tensor models a and b, and E in the derived category over S, the functors F(P) = a.tensor(D(E) ⊗ P) and G(P) = D(E ⊗ b.tensor(L(P))) admit integer-shift structures and are triangulated.

proof.text: For either native ringed pro-etale site and any fixed derived coefficient M, take a flat-term K-flat resolution P of a complex representing M. Its augmentation gives Q(P) ≅ M. Convert termwise tensor exactness to site-flatness through siteSheafTensorRightIso.

Use the published fixed-K-flat tensor theorem to give the canonical derived tensor with Q(P) its integer shifts and triangulatedness, together with the natural comparison cL from localized total tensor.

The existing fixed-tensor representative comparison for the supplied model gives d from the same localized total tensor to Q followed by its fixed-Q(P) functor. The identity-component uncurrying isomorphism identifies the two total functors. Lift cL inverse followed by this isomorphism and d through derived localization to an isomorphism of fixed derived functors.

Compose with the supplied tensor model applied to Q(P) ≅ M in the first variable. Transport the canonical fixed tensor shifts along this natural isomorphism using CommShift.ofIso. Its compatibility theorem and isTriangulated_of_iso transport triangulatedness. Apply this argument to M = Rf_*E and to M = E. Exact derived pullback and K-injective derived direct image carry their existing shift and triangulated instances; the composition instance gives the target coefficient functor. Pair the two shift structures and exactness proofs.

proof_origin.place: Tags 06YS and 06YU: resolve the fixed coefficient and identify the two localized tensor functors; Tag 06YM: exact total tensor. Lean transport uses the published fixed-K-flat tensor theorem and the existing normalized fixed-tensor comparison, without introducing any new obligations.

lean.statement:
theorem proEtaleProjectionMateShiftData :
    ∃ (sF : ((Functor.curryObj a.tensor).obj
        ((proEtaleRingDerivedDirectImage f R S c).obj E)).CommShift ℤ)
      (sG : (proEtaleRingDerivedPullback f R S c ⋙
        (Functor.curryObj b.tensor).obj E ⋙
          proEtaleRingDerivedDirectImage f R S c).CommShift ℤ),
      ((Functor.curryObj a.tensor).obj
        ((proEtaleRingDerivedDirectImage f R S c).obj E)).IsTriangulated ∧
      (proEtaleRingDerivedPullback f R S c ⋙
        (Functor.curryObj b.tensor).obj E ⋙
          proEtaleRingDerivedDirectImage f R S c).IsTriangulated
